title: The 10-point plan for the conditional ceasefire, according to Iran
byline: Iran’s 10-point proposal that it sent to the United States includes controlled transit through the straight of Hormuz coordinated with the Iranian armed forces, ending the war against Iran and allied groups, and the withdrawal of U.S. combat forces from all regional bases, according to Iranian media.

title: Gold rises 2.3%, extends gains after Trump announces Iran ceasefire
byline: Gold extended gains on Wednesday as markets reassessed near-term risks after U.S. President Donald Trump said he had agreed to suspend bombing and attacks on Iran for two weeks.

title: US and Iran agree to two-week ceasefire
byline: Donald Trump says that after discussions with the leadership of Pakistan there will be a ceasefire between the US and Iran if Iran agrees to allow traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Pakistan invites US and Iran to Islamabad talks; says ceasefire extends ‘everywhere’
byline: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif praised the announcement of a ceasefire between the United States, Iran, and their allies, saying it covers “everywhere,” including Lebanon.

title: “Not end of War”: Iran’s Mojtaba Khamenei after accepting two-week ceasefire
byline: Iran’s supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei has instructed all its military units to stop firing after agreeing to two-week ceasefire with the United States. But, at the same time, it made it clear that this is not the end of a war.

title: Oil prices plunge 12% after Trump agrees to suspend ‘bombing and attack of Iran’ for 2 weeks
byline: Oil prices plunged and U.S. stock futures soared Tuesday evening after President Donald Trump announced “a double sided ceasefire” in the war with Iran at the request of Pakistan, who has been serving as an intermediary in recent talks.

title: Showers expected in several provinces after 1pm
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern and North-western provinces and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya and Monaragala districts after 1.00 p.m.

title: Missile attacks reported across Gulf and Israel after ceasefire announced
byline: Sirens are sounding across the Gulf and in Israel as several countries report incoming missiles early Wednesday after President Donald Trump said the US had agreed to a two-week ceasefire with Iran.

title: Iran formally agrees to ceasefire and to open Strait of Hormuz if attacks stop
byline: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has announced Iran will agree to a ceasefire “if attacks against Iran are halted”.

title: Israel agrees to suspend bombing of Iran after Trump announcement
byline: Israel has agreed to suspend its bombing of Iran for a two-week period after Donald Trump announced a temporary ceasefire.

title: MPs to debate Sri Lanka’s prevailing situation in Parliament today
byline: An adjournment motion regarding the current situation in Sri Lanka, to be moved by the government is scheduled to be debated today (08) in Parliament.

title: Hezbollah halts attacks on Israel after US-Iran ceasefire
byline: Hezbollah has stopped its attacks on Israeli troops and its territory since the US-Iran ceasefire announcement, sources close to the group have told the Reuters news agency.

title: Greece to ban social media for under-15s from 2027, PM says
byline: Greece will ban access to social media for children under the age of 15 from January 1, 2027, Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis said on Wednesday, citing rising anxiety, sleep problems and the addictive design of online platforms.

title: Strengthening local industries a key priority of govt – President
byline: Strengthening local industries is a primary objective of the Government, and there are plans to expand opportunities for domestic businesses in meeting Government procurement needs in the future, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake stated.

title: More than 15 countries planning to facilitate Strait of Hormuz access, Macron says
byline: French President Emmanuel Macron said about 15 countries were planning to facilitate the resumption of traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, through which a fifth of the world’s oil supply usually flows, after a ceasefire between the United States ⁠and Iran was announced.

title: CSE records strong gains as ASPI surges over 4%
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) recorded notable gains today, with the All Share Price Index (ASPI) increasing by 885.14 points, representing a rise of 4.21%.

title: Scam Alert: Public warned over misuse of ID Office contact details
byline: The Department for Registration of Persons has issued a warning to the public regarding a group attempting to collect personal information by misusing the department’s official contact details.

title: Sri Lanka’s official reserve assets decline by 3.5% in March 2026
byline: Sri Lanka’s official reserve assets declined by 3.5% to USD 7,019 million in March 2026, compared to USD 7,270 million recorded in February 2026.

title: Israel tells people in Lebanese city to evacuate ‘immediately’
byline: The Israeli military has issued a new evacuation order for people living in the Lebanese city of Tyre, in the country’s south.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for most parts of the country
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for tomorrow (09) for residents of the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, Eastern, North-Western, Northern and North-Central provinces and in Monaragala District.

title: Malaysia, Japan and Australia welcome US-Iran ceasefire
byline: Leaders across Asia have welcomed a newly announced two-week ceasefire between the United States, Israel and Iran, expressing cautious optimism that it could pave the way for a broader resolution to the conflict in the Middle East.

title: Iran and Oman to charge ships passing through Strait of Hormuz during ceasefire, state media says
byline: Iran and Oman plan to charge transit fees for vessels passing through the Strait of Hormuz during the two-week ceasefire, according to Iran’s semi-official Tasnim News Agency.

title: Israel says ceasefire with Iran doesn’t include war in Lebanon against Hezbollah
byline: In a statement Wednesday morning, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office said it supports Trump’s decision to suspend strikes against Iran for two weeks, but that it doesn’t include the war with Hezbollah in Lebanon.

title: Sri Lanka’s official poverty line declines
byline: Sri Lanka’s official poverty line has declined in February, 2026 in comparison to figures from January, the Department of Census and Statistics has revealed.

title: Several arrested over internal fraud at NDB Bank
byline: Police have arrested several individuals, including a manager of the National Development Bank (NDB), in connection with an internal financial fraud at the institution.

title: Colombo Dockyard and Dredging Corporation of India sign MoU for maritime cooperation
byline: Indian High Commissioner to Sri Lanka Santosh Jha took part in the signing of the MoU for Cooperation between Colombo Dockyard and Dredging Corporation of India.

title: Iraq reopens airspace after weeks of disruption linked to regional tensions
byline: Iraq has reopened its airspace to civil aviation after an improvement in security conditions, allowing flights to resume across one of the region’s key air corridors.

title: Trump announces 50% tariffs on nations supplying Iran with weapons
byline: The U.S. will impose tariffs of 50% on “any and all” goods imported to the country from any nation “supplying military weapons to Iran”, President Donald Trump said on Wednesday.

title: India orders major airports to cut some charges by 25%, in relief to airlines
byline: India’s airport tariff regulator has ordered major airports to cut landing and parking charges by 25% for three months for domestic flights, offering relief to the country’s airlines that are under financial pressure due to the Iran war.

title: Special notice from Dept. for Registration of Persons
byline: The Department for Registration of Persons says efforts are currently underway to restore its computer system to resume normal operations.

title: PM Harini instructs officials to promptly complete compensation payments to those affected by Cyclone Ditwah
byline: Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya has instructed officials to expedite the completion of compensation payments for those affected by the disaster caused by Cyclone Ditwah.

title: 12-hour water cut in Padukka and several areas today
byline: A 12-hour water cut will be imposed in Padukka and several areas today due to the prevailing dry weather conditions, the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced.

title: LIOC increases diesel prices with effect from today
byline: Lanka IOC PLC (LIOC) has announced an increase in the prices of several fuel categories, effective from today (08).

title: Health Ministry issues set of guidelines for Avurudu games
byline: The Directorate of Non-Communicable Diseases of the Ministry of Health has issued a set of guidelines to prevent accidents and acute medical conditions during traditional Avurudu games and events organized during the Sinhala and Tamil New Year festive season in Sri Lanka.

title: Northern Line train services to resume tomorrow; extra trains for festive season
byline: Train services on the Northern Line, which were disrupted following Cyclone Ditwah, will resume from tomorrow (09), according to Sri Lanka Railways.

title: Dr. Sulakshana Jayawardena named acting BOI Chairman
byline: The Board of Investment (BOI) of Sri Lanka has announced the appointment of Dr. Sulakshana Jayawardena as its acting Chairman.

title: Iran says Lavan Island refinery came under attack after ceasefire announced
byline: An oil refinery on Iran’s Lavan Island came under attack Wednesday, hours after a ceasefire in the war was announced, Iranian state television reported.

title: White House deems two-week ceasefire “a victory for the United States”
byline: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt called the two-week ceasefire “a victory for the United States,” as she touted the US military’s efforts in the war with Iran.

title: Renovated Colombo Pettah Central Bus Stand declared opened
byline: The newly renovated Pettah Central Bus Stand has been officially opened to the public today (08).

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, Uva and North-Western provinces and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya districts.

title: CAA assures continuous Laugfs gas supply during festive period
byline: Steps have been taken to ensure an uninterrupted supply of Laugfs gas to consumers during the festive season, starting today (April 8), the Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) announced.

title: Catering and reception hall charges increased
byline: The All Island Banquet Owners and Caterers Association has announced an increase in fees charged so far for reception halls and catering services with effect from today (08).

title: Trump declares Iran ‘regime change,’ vows no enrichment and nuclear removal
byline: US President Donald Trump declared that Iran has undergone what he called a “very productive Regime Change.”

title: Iran to approach peace talks with US with caution, Iranian ambassador to UN says
byline: Iran will approach peace talks with the U.S. with greater caution than in the past due to a deep lack of trust, and the war will affect the future legal regime of the Strait of Hormuz, Iran’s ambassador to the U.N. in Geneva said on Wednesday.

title: Zelenskiy, welcoming Iran de-escalation, says Ukraine ready for ceasefire with Russia
byline: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Wednesday he welcomed the ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran, adding that Kyiv was ready to “respond in kind” if Moscow ceased strikes.

title: 12-hour water cut announced for several areas in Mattegoda tomorrow
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced a 12-hour water cut for Mattegoda and surrounding areas tomorrow (09).

title: Kuwait Airways to recommence Colombo operations from Apr. 15
byline: Kuwait Airways, the national carrier of the State of Kuwait, will officially commence flight operations to Colombo from April 15.

title: Sri Lanka assures fullest support to ensure peace and stability in Middle East
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has affirmed that Sri Lanka, both as an individual nation and collectively with others will extend its fullest possible support within the framework of international law, towards ensuring peace, security, and stability in the Middle East.

title: UN Secretary General welcomes ceasefire in Middle East
byline: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres welcomed the announcement of a two-week ceasefire by the US and Iran, his spokesman Stephane Dujarric said Tuesday.

title: Registrar General’s Dept. launches new call center and modernized website
byline: The Registrar General’s Department has launched a new call center and a modernized website to ensure efficient service to the general public.

title: Daddy Yankee named Latin Recording Academy Person of the Year 2026
byline: The Latin Recording Academy will honor Ramón Luis Ayala Rodríguez - a.k.a. Daddy Yankee - as the 2026 Latin Recording Academy Person of the Year.

title: Wealthy nations slashed development aid in 2025 for second year in row, debt group says
byline: Wealthy nations slashed their development aid in 2025, probably by record-breaking amounts, a debt group said, ahead of data set to be released on Thursday by the Paris-based Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development.
